text:
Conflict card:

Input: age_days = 60, escrow_lock = true, context = edge.

This input matches Rule A - Rotate certificates once their age reaches sixty days - which requires action: rotate.

It also matches Rule B - An escrow lock requires keeping the current certificate - which requires action: keep_current.

The actions rotate and keep_current are incompatible and cannot both be done.

Which rule wins for this case?
cost_basis: all terminal provider usage, persisted from first request
